name: why
purpose: Investigate historical motivation, design rationale, regressions, postmortems and data-backed thresholds with cited confidence tiers.
triggers: why does X work this way
Design rationale, regressions, postmortems or threshold origins
inputs: Files, symbols, commits, PRs and ticket leads
Available authorized source reads and worker capabilities
outputs: The Question, The Code in Question, What We Found, What We Can Reasonably Infer, Competing Hypotheses, What We Don’t Know, Sources Consulted, Confidence Summary
Seven-category coverage, exact queries, citations, contradictions and explicit gaps
Preserve / Change / Avoid / Risk constraints when a code change is contemplated
ordinaryExample: Trace a retry threshold through git history, PR discussion, a linked ticket and release telemetry, separating stated rationale from correlation.
capabilityLimits: Missing connectors and authenticated PR reads remain explicit gaps.
Unavailable independent workers require disclosed sequential reduced capability.
Read-only investigation preserves private-record visibility and requires separate authorization for external writes.
Invocation metadata is preserved without assuming host enforcement.
Host behavior has not been tested.
